title: CAREER CONTROLS LIST FOLDED, MID-BOTTOM LEFT
why: His answer rs-1 (2026-10-24): the keys list should sit mid-bottom left, minimized, a key reveals it. A career raid starts with the list folded; the folded f1 line moves down to stand where the opened list stands, so F1 opens it upward from there. The demo keeps its own start.
now: Career raids start with the controls list folded; the folded f1 line stands at the lower left beside the feed, and F1 opens the list upward from it.
